It is also one of those which can most easily be experienced. The soil of France is so impregnated with history!

arxiv-1712-05450.description: A 2017 arXiv research paper by Nitish Korula, Vahab Mirrokni, Morteza Zadimoghaddam. In the Submodular Welfare Maximization (SWM) problem, the input consists of a set of n n items, each of which must be allocated to one of m m agents. Each agent ℓ \ell has a valuation function v ℓ v_{\ell} , where v ℓ ​ ( S ) v_{\ell}(S) denotes the welfare obtained by this agent if she receives the set of items S S .

arxiv-2104-02989.title: The influence of the secular perturbation of an intermediate-mass companion: II. Ejection of hypervelocity stars from the Galactic Center Journal: ApJ REBOUND ( Rein & Liu 2012 ; Rein et al. 2019 )
arxiv-2104-02989.creator: Xiaochen Zheng （郑晓晨）, Douglas N. C. Lin (林潮), Shude Mao (毛淑德)
arxiv-2104-02989.description: Abstract There is a population of stars with velocities in excess of 500 km s -1 relative to the Galactic center. Many, perhaps most, of these hyper-velocity stars (HVSs) are B stars, similar to the disk and S stars in a nuclear cluster around a super- massive black hole (SMBH) near Sgr ​ A ⋆ \rm Sgr~A^{\star} .

arxiv-2211-11096.title: Let Offline RL Flow: Training Conservative Agents in the Latent Space of Normalizing Flows
arxiv-2211-11096.creator: Dmitry Akimov, Vladislav Kurenkov, Alexander Nikulin, Denis Tarasov, Sergey Kolesnikov
arxiv-2211-11096.description: Abstract Offline reinforcement learning aims to train a policy on a pre-recorded and fixed dataset without any additional environment interactions. There are two major challenges in this setting: (1) extrapolation error caused by approximating the value of state-action pairs not well-covered by the training data and (2) distributional shift between behavior and inference policies.

arxiv-2307-07028.title: The Bohr Radius of the Weighted Bloch Spaces
arxiv-2307-07028.creator: Khasyanov R.Sh
arxiv-2307-07028.description: Abstract The concept of the Bohr radius of a pair of Banach spaces is introduced. The lower estimate for the value of the Bohr radius from the Bloch space to the space of bounded functions obtained by I. Kayumov, S. Ponnusamy and N. Shakirov is slightly improved.

arxiv-2308-12964.title: Dense Text-to-Image Generation with Attention Modulation
arxiv-2308-12964.creator: Yunji Kim, Jiyoung Lee, Jin-Hwa Kim, Jung-Woo Ha, Jun-Yan Zhu
arxiv-2308-12964.description: Abstract Existing text-to-image diffusion models struggle to synthesize realistic images given dense captions, where each text prompt provides a detailed description for a specific image region. To address this, we propose DenseDiffusion, a training-free method that adapts a pre-trained text-to-image model to handle such dense captions while offering control over the scene layout.

arxiv-2309-06128.title: Exploring Anisotropic flow via the Boltzmann Transport Equation Employing the Tsallis Blast Wave Description at LHC energies
arxiv-2309-06128.creator: Aviral Akhil, Swatantra Kumar Tiwari
arxiv-2309-06128.description: Abstract Anisotropic flows i . e . i.e. azimuthal anisotropies in the particle production are one of the important probes in characterizing the properties of the strongly interacting matter created in the relativistic heavy-ion collisions. These observables are sensitive to both the transport properties as well as the equation of state (EOS) of the Quantum Chromodynamics (QCD) matter.

arxiv-2405-02677.title: Evaluating the Ability of Computationally Extracted Narrative Maps to Encode Media Framing
arxiv-2405-02677.creator: Sebastian Concha Macías, Brian Keith Norambuena
arxiv-2405-02677.description: Abstract Narratives serve as fundamental frameworks in our understanding of the world and play a crucial role in collaborative sensemaking, providing a versatile foundation for sensemaking. Framing is a subtle yet potent mechanism that influences public perception through specific word choices, shaping interpretations of reported news events.

arxiv-2405-09283.title: Bounds and Approximations for the Distribution of a Sum of Lognormal Random Variables
arxiv-2405-09283.creator: Fredrik Berggren
arxiv-2405-09283.description: Abstract A sum of lognormal random variables (RVs) appears in many problems of science and engineering. For example, it is invloved in computing the distribution of recevied signal and interference powers for radio channels subject to lognormal shadow fading. Its distribution has no closed-from expression and it is typically characterized by approximations, asymptotes or bounds.

arxiv-2409-10090.title: MotionCom: Automatic and Motion-Aware Image Composition with LLM and Video Diffusion Prior
arxiv-2409-10090.creator: Weijing Tao, Xiaofeng Yang, Miaomiao Cui, Guosheng Lin
arxiv-2409-10090.description: Abstract This work presents MotionCom, a training-free motion-aware diffusion based image composition, enabling automatic and seamless integration of target objects into new scenes with dynamically coherent results without finetuning or optimization. Traditional approaches in this area suffer from two significant limitations: they require manual planning for object placement and often generate static compositions lacking motion realism.

arxiv-2507-14242.description: Abstract . While Artificial Intelligence (AI) is not a new field, recent developments, especially with the release of generative tools like ChatGPT, have brought it to the forefront of the minds of industry workers and academic folk alike. There is currently much talk about AI and its ability to reshape many everyday processes as we know them through automation.

europmc-pmc6093935.title: Genome-wide mapping of plasma protein QTLs identifies putatively causal genes and pathways for cardiovascular disease.
europmc-pmc6093935.creator: Yao C, Chen G, Song C, Keefe J, Mendelson M, Huan T, Sun BB, Laser A, Maranville JC, Wu H, Ho JE, Courchesne P, Lyass A, Larson MG, Gieger C, Graumann J, Johnson AD, Danesh J, Runz H, Hwang SJ, Liu C, Butterworth AS, Suhre K, Levy D.
europmc-pmc6093935.description: Identifying genetic variants associated with circulating protein concentrations (protein quantitative trait loci; pQTLs) and integrating them with variants from genome-wide association studies (GWAS) may illuminate the proteome's causal role in disease and bridge a knowledge gap

pmc-11512132.title: Seasonal and Weekly Patterns of Korean Adolescents’ Web Search Activity on Insomnia: Retrospective Study
pmc-11512132.creator: Kwangyeol Baek, Jake Jeong, Hyun-Woo Kim, Dong-Hyeon Shin, Jiyoung Kim, Gha-Hyun Lee, Jae Wook Cho, Amaryllis Mavragani, Jee Kim
pmc-11512132.description: BackgroundSleep deprivation in adolescents is a common but serious public health issue. Adolescents often have a progressive circadian delay and suffer from insufficient sleep during weekdays due to the school schedule. Temporal patterns in internet search activity data can provide relevant information for understanding the characteristic sleep problems of the adolescent population.

pmc-12364969.title: Mapping cross-modal functional connectivity of major neurotransmitter systems in the human brain
pmc-12364969.creator: C Saiz-Masvidal, V De la Peña-Arteaga, S Bertolín, I Diez, A Juaneda-Seguí, I Martínez-Zalacaín, P Chavarría-Elizondo, M Subirà, J M Menchón, J Sepulcre, Miquel Àngel Fullana, Carles Soriano-Mas
pmc-12364969.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Monoaminergic systems, including serotonin, dopamine, and norepinephrine, are essential for regulating brain activity and facilitating behavioral flexibility. These systems originate from brainstem nuclei and project widely to modulate functions such as mood, attention, memory, and adaptability. Using resting-state functional MRI (rs-fMRI), this study aimed to investigate the connectivity networks of key monoaminergic nuclei in 193 healthy adults and explore their correspondence with molecular imaging maps of neurotransmitter-specific biochemical markers.

pmc-12432596.title: Associations of body composition and inflammatory parameters with survival in patients with resectable non-small cell lung cancer receiving neoadjuvant chemoimmunotherapy
pmc-12432596.creator: Yuting Zheng, Qinyue Luo, Yimeng He, Hanting Li, Mengting Huang, Chengyu Ding, Xiaoyu Han, Heshui Shi
pmc-12432596.description: BackgroundThe predictive value of body composition and inflammatory parameters in patients with resectable non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) undergoing neoadjuvant chemoimmunotherapy remains poorly defined. The study sought to evaluate the association between computed tomography (CT)-based body composition, inflammatory markers, and survival outcomes in NSCLC patients following neoadjuvant chemoimmunotherapy.

pmc-12450606.title: Successful Treatment of Refractory Candida auris Ventriculitis With Intraventricular Liposomal Amphotericin B
pmc-12450606.creator: Christine A Vu, Kelsey Ladd, Folusakin O Ayoade
pmc-12450606.description: We report on a case of a patient in their early 60's with a history of traumatic brain injury, decompressive cranioplasty, and chronic ventriculoperitoneal (VP) shunt who presented from a nursing home with altered mental status and status epilepticus. He was found to have Candida auris growing from his cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) cultures.

pmc-12572344.title: A global land daily 10-km-resolution surface ozone dataset from 2013–2022
pmc-12572344.creator: Rui Wang, Huanfeng Shen, Chao Zeng, Jiajia Chen, Yuan Wang, Yuyu Li
pmc-12572344.description: Global ozone pollution has increased recently. Key aspects of global ozone pollution and its health assessment are not yet fully understood owing to the limited temporal resolution of existing datasets. In this study, a global surface ozone dataset was developed, providing 0.1° daily maximum 8-hour average surface ozone for 2013–2022.

pmc-12606889.title: Congenital oculomotor nerve palsy with aberrant eyelid movements and pupillary spasms: a case report
pmc-12606889.creator: Donghun Lee, Geun Woo Lee, Sook Hyun Yoon, Jae Han Park, Sook Young Kim
pmc-12606889.description: BackgroundWe report a case of congenital oculomotor nerve palsy presenting with aberrant eyelid movements and an involuntary pupillary reaction.Case PresentationA 24-year-old woman presented with mild anisocoria with no significant medical history. Her ocular history included a history of strabismus and levator muscle surgery. Examination revealed exotropia, hypotropia, and ocular motility impairment, consistent with right oculomotor nerve palsy.

pmc-12717787.title: Glucagon‐Like Peptide‐2 (GLP‐2) Analogues in Patients With Short Bowel Syndrome Dependent on Parenteral Support: A Systematic Review and Meta‐Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
pmc-12717787.creator: Arsalan Hyder, Ankit Alria, Adnan Rafiq, Muhammad Faiq Akram, Talha Hassan, Eshah Fatima Ali, Farheen Vhora, Shajia Khan, Shah Gul Zahra, Muhammad Arslan Niazi, Uzair Jafar, Huzaifa Ahmad Cheema, Asma'a Munasar Ali Alsubari, Faryal Altaf, Adnan Bhat, Essam Rashad, Prasun Kumar Jalal
pmc-12717787.description: Background and ObjectiveShort bowel syndrome (SBS) is a malabsorptive condition often requiring long‐term parenteral support (PS), which is associated with significant complications. Glucagon‐like peptide‐2 (GLP‐2) analogues are shown to enhance intestinal adaptation and reduce PS dependency. This systematic review and meta‐analysis aimed to evaluate the efficacy and safety of GLP‐2 analogues in adult patients with SBS dependent on PS.

pmc-12732135.title: Expanding Participation in Inclusive Physical Education: A Maker-Based Approach for Sport-Marginalized Students
pmc-12732135.creator: Yongchul Kwon, Donghyun Kim, Minseo Kang, Gunsang Cho, Adrián Mateo-Orcajada, Raquel Vaquero-Cristobal, Mario Demófilo Albaladejo-Saura
pmc-12732135.description: Highlights What are the main findings? •Three distinct maker-based lesson types were developed: (1) physical data measurement and analysis, (2) performance feedback, and (3) play- and game-based activities. These lessons expanded participation among sport-marginalized students by offering alternative and meaningful roles.•Teachers reported shifts in their perceptions of inclusion, which led to instructional redesign and reconfiguration of their professional identity.

pmc-12801507.title: Unveiling the role of angiogenesis-related biomarkers in diabetic nephropathy via transcriptomics
pmc-12801507.creator: Shiyu Zhao, Cuiping Yang, Linlin Gao, Xuemei Fan, Shiwei Liu
pmc-12801507.description: BackgroundDiabetic nephropathy (DN), a common complication of diabetes, is characterized by structural and functional renal damage. Angiogenesis plays a pivotal role in both physiological and pathological renal processes. This study explored angiogenesis-related biomarkers in DN to provide theoretical insights for clinical practice.

pmc-13066444.title: METTL3-mediated fibroblast-like synoviocytes senescence promotes temporomandibular joint osteoarthritis progression
pmc-13066444.creator: Kun Tian, Qin Du, Jun Guo, Wen Liao, Xianrui Yang, Shuang Lai, Juan Liao, Yandong Mu, Li Xiao
pmc-13066444.description: Temporomandibular joint osteoarthritis (TMJOA) is a disease that affects the TMJ and is associated with degenerative changes in the articular cartilage. Fibroblast-like synoviocytes (FLSs) have been found to contribute to osteoarthritis. Here, we aim to investigate the role of METTL3-mediated FLS senescence in the TMJOA process.

pmc-13221850.title: High Lipoprotein(a) in Cardiovascular Disease
pmc-13221850.creator: Peter E. Thomas, Pia R. Kamstrup
pmc-13221850.description: Corresponding Author High lipoprotein(a), present in 1 in 5 individuals, is a genetically determined, causal, but often overlooked, risk factor for atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD).1 Although large-scale routine clinical measurement is possible, implementing this in clinical practice lags behind both the evidence and most guideline recommendations.

pmc-13334033.title: Effect analysis of soil texture and water content on soil adhesive force based on the discrete element method
pmc-13334033.creator: Dae-Wi Jeong, Min-Seung Kim, Se-O Choi, Shin-Young Noh, Yeon-Soo Kim, Wan-Soo Kim, Seung-Yun Baek, Yong-Joo Kim
pmc-13334033.description: Understanding soil–metal adhesion under varying moisture and texture conditions is essential for predicting soil–tool interactions in agricultural machinery. However, despite its importance, research that directly quantifies soil adhesion and provides physically based parameters for modeling remains limited, particularly across the diverse conditions encountered in field operations.

pmc-13604204.title: Abdominal Obesity, Testosterone Deficiency and Sedentary Lifestyle in Young Men from the General Population: The Relationship with Semen Quality, Hormonal and Metabolic Status
pmc-13604204.creator: Ludmila Osadchuk, Alexander Osadchuk
pmc-13604204.description: Background: The demographic crisis observed in industrialized countries has been accompanied by a decline in the reproductive potential of human populations. One of the causes for the global deterioration in men’s reproductive health is adiposity and sedentary lifestyle, leading to reduced fertility and a decrease in androgen status.
